lines.say: Every Nepali hospital has a rate list: "O P D ticket – Rs 500", "C B C – Rs 600", "X-ray chest – Rs 800".

lines.raw: In the US, every service also has a standard **code**, so every doctor and every insurer means exactly the same thing.
lines.say: In the U S, every service also has a standard code, so every doctor and every insurer means exactly the same thing.

lines.say: Think of barcodes in a supermarket.

lines.raw: Every product in a Bhatbhateni store has a barcode.
lines.say: Every product in a Bhatbhateni store has a barcode.

lines.raw: The cashier scans the code, not the name.
lines.say: The cashier scans the code, not the name.

lines.raw: Procedure codes are the **barcodes of healthcare services**.
lines.say: Procedure codes are the barcodes of healthcare services.

lines.raw: CPT: codes for what doctors do.
lines.say: C P T: codes for what doctors do.

scenes.section: CPT: codes for what doctors do

lines.raw: **CPT** (Current Procedural Terminology) codes are **5 characters** long and cover medical, surgical and diagnostic services.
lines.say: C P T (Current Procedural Terminology) codes are 5 characters long and cover medical, surgical and diagnostic services.

lines.raw: Most are all numbers (`99213`), but some **end with a letter** (`1000F`, `0016T`).
lines.say: Most are all numbers (9 9 2 1 3), but some end with a letter (1 0 0 0 F, 0 0 1 6 T).

lines.raw: They are owned and updated every year by the **American Medical Association (AMA)**.
lines.say: They are owned and updated every year by the American Medical Association (A M A).

scenes.section: CPT: codes for what doctors do

lines.raw: Common CPT codes.
lines.say: Common C P T codes.

lines.raw: `99203`. Meaning: Office visit, **new** patient. Nepal rate-list equivalent: New OPD ticket + consultation.
lines.say: 9 9 2 0 3. Meaning: Office visit, new patient. Nepal rate-list equivalent: New O P D ticket and consultation.

lines.raw: `99213`. Meaning: Office visit, **existing** patient. Nepal rate-list equivalent: Follow-up OPD visit.
lines.say: 9 9 2 1 3. Meaning: Office visit, existing patient. Nepal rate-list equivalent: Follow-up O P D visit.

lines.raw: `99284`. Meaning: Emergency room visit (moderate). Nepal rate-list equivalent: Emergency consultation.
lines.say: 9 9 2 8 4. Meaning: Emergency room visit (moderate). Nepal rate-list equivalent: Emergency consultation.

lines.raw: `85025`. Meaning: Complete blood count (CBC). Nepal rate-list equivalent: CBC test.
lines.say: 8 5 0 2 5. Meaning: Complete blood count (C B C). Nepal rate-list equivalent: C B C test.

lines.raw: `87880`. Meaning: Rapid strep test. Nepal rate-list equivalent: Throat swab test.
lines.say: 8 7 8 8 0. Meaning: Rapid strep test. Nepal rate-list equivalent: Throat swab test.

lines.raw: `71046`. Meaning: Chest X-ray, 2 views. Nepal rate-list equivalent: X-ray chest PA & lateral.
lines.say: 7 1 0 4 6. Meaning: Chest X-ray, 2 views. Nepal rate-list equivalent: X-ray chest P A and lateral.

lines.raw: `36415`. Meaning: Taking blood from a vein. Nepal rate-list equivalent: Blood sample collection.
lines.say: 3 6 4 1 5. Meaning: Taking blood from a vein. Nepal rate-list equivalent: Blood sample collection.

lines.raw: `44970`. Meaning: Keyhole (laparoscopic) appendix removal. Nepal rate-list equivalent: Lap appendectomy.
lines.say: 4 4 9 7 0. Meaning: Keyhole (laparoscopic) appendix removal. Nepal rate-list equivalent: Lap appendectomy.

scenes.section: CPT: codes for what doctors do

lines.raw: Where is the letter?
lines.say: Where is the letter?

lines.raw: In a **CPT** code, a letter can only come at the **end** (`0016T`).
lines.say: In a C P T code, a letter can only come at the end (0 0 1 6 T).

lines.raw: If a code **starts** with a letter (`J1100`, `A0429`), it is a **HCPCS Level II** code, not CPT.
lines.say: If a code starts with a letter (J 1 1 0 0, A 0 4 2 9), it is a H C P C S Level I I code, not C P T.

lines.raw: This is the quickest way to tell them apart in data.
lines.say: This is the quickest way to tell them apart in data.

lines.raw: HCPCS: codes for things CPT does not cover.
lines.say: H C P C S: codes for things C P T does not cover.

scenes.section: HCPCS: codes for things CPT does not cover

lines.raw: **HCPCS** (said "hick-picks") is the Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System, managed by **CMS** (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, the US government's health agency).
lines.say: H C P C S (said "hick-picks") is the Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System, managed by C M S (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, the U S government's health agency).

lines.raw: **Level I** of HCPCS is simply CPT.
lines.say: Level I of H C P C S is simply C P T.

lines.raw: **Level II** codes are **1 letter + 4 digits** and cover supplies, equipment, ambulance rides and some drugs.
lines.say: Level I I codes are 1 letter and 4 digits and cover supplies, equipment, ambulance rides and some drugs.

scenes.section: HCPCS: codes for things CPT does not cover

lines.raw: HCPCS Level II examples.
lines.say: H C P C S Level I I examples.

lines.raw: `A0429`. Meaning: Ambulance, basic life support, emergency. Letter group: A = transport & supplies.
lines.say: A 0 4 2 9. Meaning: Ambulance, basic life support, emergency. Letter group: A = transport and supplies.

lines.raw: `E0114`. Meaning: Crutches (pair). Letter group: E = durable medical equipment.
lines.say: E 0 1 1 4. Meaning: Crutches (pair). Letter group: E = durable medical equipment.

lines.raw: `J1100`. Meaning: Dexamethasone injection, 1 mg. Letter group: J = drugs given by injection.
lines.say: J 1 1 0 0. Meaning: Dexamethasone injection, 1 mg. Letter group: J = drugs given by injection.

lines.raw: `L3908`. Meaning: Wrist splint. Letter group: L = orthotics & prosthetics.
lines.say: L 3 9 0 8. Meaning: Wrist splint. Letter group: L = orthotics and prosthetics.

lines.raw: `G0008`. Meaning: Giving a flu vaccine (Medicare). Letter group: G = temporary procedures.
lines.say: G 0 0 0 8. Meaning: Giving a flu vaccine (Medicare). Letter group: G = temporary procedures.

lines.raw: Modifiers: small tags with big meaning.
lines.say: Modifiers: small tags with big meaning.

scenes.section: Modifiers: small tags with big meaning

lines.raw: A **modifier** is a **2-character tag** added to a CPT or HCPCS code.
lines.say: A modifier is a 2-character tag added to a C P T or H C P C S code.

lines.raw: It does not change what the service is; it adds a detail about **how** or **why** it was done differently.
lines.say: It does not change what the service is; it adds a detail about how or why it was done differently.

scenes.section: Modifiers: small tags with big meaning

lines.raw: A code with a modifier.
lines.say: A code with a modifier.

lines.raw: 73110: CPT: **X-ray of the wrist**, 3 or more views.
lines.say: 73110: C P T: X-ray of the wrist, 3 or more views.

lines.raw: RT: Modifier: done on the **right** side.
lines.say: R T: Modifier: done on the right side.

scenes.section: Modifiers: small tags with big meaning

lines.raw: Modifiers you will see often.
lines.say: Modifiers you will see often.

lines.raw: `25`. Meaning: A separate, significant visit on the same day as a procedure. Simple example: Doctor treats a cut and also checks blood pressure problems.
lines.say: 25. Meaning: A separate, significant visit on the same day as a procedure. Simple example: Doctor treats a cut and also checks blood pressure problems.

lines.raw: `50`. Meaning: Done on **both** sides of the body. Simple example: X-ray of both knees.
lines.say: 50. Meaning: Done on both sides of the body. Simple example: X-ray of both knees.

lines.raw: `RT` / `LT`. Meaning: Right side / Left side. Simple example: Right wrist X-ray.
lines.say: R T or L T. Meaning: Right side or Left side. Simple example: Right wrist X-ray.

lines.raw: `26`. Meaning: Only the **doctor's reading** part. Simple example: Radiologist reads the X-ray.
lines.say: 26. Meaning: Only the doctor's reading part. Simple example: Radiologist reads the X-ray.

lines.raw: `TC`. Meaning: Only the **machine/technical** part. Simple example: Hospital takes the X-ray picture.
lines.say: T C. Meaning: Only the machine/technical part. Simple example: Hospital takes the X-ray picture.

lines.raw: `59`. Meaning: A distinct, separate procedure. Simple example: Two different procedures that normally aren't billed together.
lines.say: 59. Meaning: A distinct, separate procedure. Simple example: Two different procedures that normally aren't billed together.

scenes.section: Modifiers: small tags with big meaning

lines.raw: Why modifiers 26 and TC exist.
lines.say: Why modifiers 26 and T C exist.

lines.raw: An X-ray has two parts: **taking** the picture (machine + technician) and **reading** it (a radiologist).
lines.say: An X-ray has two parts: taking the picture (machine and technician) and reading it (a radiologist).

lines.raw: Often different providers do each part.
lines.say: Often different providers do each part.

lines.raw: In Nepal, you pay the X-ray fee to the hospital, and the radiologist's report is included.
lines.say: In Nepal, you pay the X-ray fee to the hospital, and the radiologist's report is included.

lines.raw: In the US, the two parts can be billed separately with `TC` and `26`.
lines.say: In the U S, the two parts can be billed separately with T C and 26.

lines.raw: Units: how many?
lines.say: Units: how many?

lines.raw: Each claim line has **units**: how many times the service was done, or how much was used.
lines.say: Each claim line has units: how many times the service was done, or how much was used.

lines.raw: If Emily got 4 mg of dexamethasone, the line would show `J1100` with **4 units** (because 1 unit = 1 mg).
lines.say: If Emily got 4 mg of dexamethasone, the line would show J 1 1 0 0 with 4 units (because 1 unit = 1 mg).

lines.raw: Here is a quick table.
lines.say: Here is a quick table.

lines.raw: 1. Code: `99284`. Units: 1. Meaning: One emergency visit.
lines.say: 1. Code: 9 9 2 8 4. Units: 1. Meaning: One emergency visit.

lines.raw: 2. Code: `J1100`. Units: 4. Meaning: 4 mg of dexamethasone.
lines.say: 2. Code: J 1 1 0 0. Units: 4. Meaning: 4 mg of dexamethasone.

lines.raw: 3. Code: `97110`. Units: 3. Meaning: Three 15-minute blocks of physiotherapy exercise.
lines.say: 3. Code: 9 7 1 1 0. Units: 3. Meaning: Three 15-minute blocks of physiotherapy exercise.

lines.raw: ICD-10-PCS: procedure codes for inpatient stays.
lines.say: I C D 10-PCS: procedure codes for inpatient stays.

scenes.section: ICD-10-PCS: procedure codes for inpatient stays

lines.raw: When a patient is **admitted**, the hospital's own (institutional) claim describes surgeries and procedures with **ICD-10-PCS** codes (PCS = Procedure Coding System), not CPT.
lines.say: When a patient is admitted, the hospital's own (institutional) claim describes surgeries and procedures with I C D 10-PCS codes (P C S = Procedure Coding System), not C P T.

lines.raw: They are always exactly **7 characters**, and each character position has a meaning.
lines.say: They are always exactly 7 characters, and each character position has a meaning.

scenes.section: ICD-10-PCS: procedure codes for inpatient stays

lines.raw: Sita's / Emily's keyhole appendix removal.
lines.say: Sita's or Emily's keyhole appendix removal.

lines.raw: 0: Section: **medical and surgical**.
lines.say: 0: Section: medical and surgical.

lines.raw: D: Body system: **gastrointestinal** (digestive).
lines.say: D: Body system: gastrointestinal (digestive).

lines.raw: T: Operation: **resection** (cut out completely).
lines.say: T: Operation: resection (cut out completely).

lines.raw: J: Body part: **appendix**.
lines.say: J: Body part: appendix.

lines.raw: 4: Approach: **through small cuts with a camera** (laparoscopic).
lines.say: 4: Approach: through small cuts with a camera (laparoscopic).

lines.raw: Z: Device: **none** left in the body.
lines.say: Z: Device: none left in the body.

lines.raw: Z: Qualifier: **none**.
lines.say: Z: Qualifier: none.

scenes.section: ICD-10-PCS: procedure codes for inpatient stays

lines.raw: Which procedure code set appears where.
lines.say: Which procedure code set appears where.

lines.raw: Professional (doctor). Procedure code set: CPT / HCPCS. Where on the claim: On each line.
lines.say: Professional (doctor). Procedure code set: C P T or H C P C S. Where on the claim: On each line.

lines.raw: Institutional, outpatient (ER, day surgery). Procedure code set: CPT / HCPCS. Where on the claim: On each line, next to a hospital department code (the revenue code, lesson 9).
lines.say: Institutional, outpatient (E R, day surgery). Procedure code set: C P T or H C P C S. Where on the claim: On each line, next to a hospital department code (the revenue code, lesson 9).

lines.raw: Institutional, inpatient (admitted). Procedure code set: ICD-10-PCS. Where on the claim: On the header, as principal and other procedures.
lines.say: Institutional, inpatient (admitted). Procedure code set: I C D 10-PCS. Where on the claim: On the header, as principal and other procedures.

scenes.section: ICD-10-PCS: procedure codes for inpatient stays

lines.raw: Don't mix them up.
lines.say: Don't mix them up.

lines.raw: **ICD-10-CM** = diagnosis (the problem, e.g. `K35.80` appendicitis).
lines.say: I C D 10-CM = diagnosis (the problem, for example K 3 5 . 8 0 appendicitis).

lines.raw: **ICD-10-PCS** = inpatient procedure (what the hospital did, e.g. `0DTJ4ZZ`).
lines.say: I C D 10-PCS = inpatient procedure (what the hospital did, for example 0 D T J 4 Z Z).

lines.raw: The surgeon's own professional claim uses CPT `44970` for the same operation.
lines.say: The surgeon's own professional claim uses C P T 4 4 9 7 0 for the same operation.

lines.raw: To count appendix removals across all claims, you must look for **both** code sets.
lines.say: To count appendix removals across all claims, you must look for both code sets.

lines.raw: Key takeaways.
lines.say: Key takeaways.

lines.raw: **CPT** = 5-character codes for doctors' services (by AMA).
lines.say: C P T = 5-character codes for doctors' services (by A M A).

lines.raw: Mostly numbers (`99213`); some end with a letter (`0016T`).
lines.say: Mostly numbers (9 9 2 1 3); some end with a letter (0 0 1 6 T).

lines.raw: **HCPCS Level II** = 1 letter + 4 digits for supplies, equipment, ambulance, drugs (by CMS).
lines.say: H C P C S Level I I = 1 letter and 4 digits for supplies, equipment, ambulance, drugs (by C M S).

lines.raw: Example: `E0114`.
lines.say: Example: E 0 1 1 4.

lines.raw: **Modifiers** are 2-character tags that add detail (side of body, separate visit, part of service).
lines.say: Modifiers are 2-character tags that add detail (side of body, separate visit, part of service).

lines.raw: **Units** tell how many times or how much of a service was given.
lines.say: Units tell how many times or how much of a service was given.

lines.raw: **ICD-10-PCS** (7 characters) describes procedures on inpatient hospital claims; the surgeon bills the same operation with CPT.
lines.say: I C D 10-PCS (7 characters) describes procedures on inpatient hospital claims; the surgeon bills the same operation with C P T.
